The easiest one bowl classic fudge brownie with a beautiful shiny flaky crust.
 

Ingredients

1/2 cup (113 grams) unsalted butter
1 cup (200 grams) granulated sugar
1/2 cup (34 grams) unsweetened cocoa powder
2 large eggs (100 grams)
1 teaspoon pure vanilla extract
3/4 cup (90 grams) all-purpose flour
Equipment

8×8 inch Baking pan

Bowl with spout

Rubber spatula

Angled spatula

Instructions
Heat oven to 350°F (175°C). Grease bottom and sides of an 8×8 inch (20×20 cm) baking pan and line it with parchment paper leaving excess parchment to hang over the sides for easy removal; set aside.
In a medium bowl, melt butter in the microwave for 30 seconds. Heat for another 10 to 15 seconds, stir partially melted butter to allow the residual heat to fully melt the remaining butter.
Whisk in sugar and cocoa. Beat in eggs and vanilla.
Using a rubber spatula, fold flour into the chocolate-mixture until it is completely blended with no dry pockets of flour; batter will be thick.  Pour batter into the prepared pan.  Using an angled spatula, evenly spread the batter across the pan. 
Bake for 35 to 40 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean. ENJOY!
